prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Deferring account sign-in after pet selection significantly harmed performance (-7.3%), making the predicted +15.0% gain far too high.
Redesigning the home intro with an interactive checklist showed no clear effect, so the +10.0% prediction was too high.
Spotlight layout changes for path selection yielded no clear effect, and the +8.0% prediction was too high.
Adding desktop overlay hints resulted in no clear effect, with predictions (+5.0%) being too high.
Predictions were consistently too high across all onboarding A/B tests.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- choose_path, layout: -2.0% over 1 test(s)
- finish, redesign: +8.6% over 1 test(s)
- home, hint: +0.7% over 1 test(s)
- sign_in, reorder: -7.3% over 1 test(s)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 17.8%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [adoption, new_flow] Guided Multi-Angle Pet Generation Validation Flow: Inserts a model validation screen 'new_photo_validator' between upload_photos and adoption_certificate to check photo quality before generation begins. (why: Adoption step has a low conversion rate (60.9%) and long completion times (mean 1017s), alongside 3 support emails reporting failed custom pet generation or bad model outputs.)
1: [adoption, incentive] Adoption Certificate Personalization Badge: Adds an official verified pet parent badge visual component to the adoption certificate screen to celebrate completing pet creation. (why: Adoption conversion is the lowest in the funnel at 60.9%; adding visual accomplishment feedback encourages users to move past certificate confirmation.)
2: [home, wait_info] Real-time Pet Generation Stage Progress Tracker: Replaces the generic wait status on the waiting screen with step-by-step progress text, dynamic timer estimate, and progress bar. (why: The waiting screen (home step) has a median completion time of 201s and a mean of 2336s, causing uncertainty and drop-off during generation.)
3: [home, notification] Background Rendering System Notification Alert: Enables system notification opt-in and extended tip delays on the waiting screen so users can safely minimize the app during pet generation. (why: Mean waiting time in home step is extremely long (2336s), suggesting users switch to other tasks and forget to return to the application.)
4: [home, new_screen] Live Desktop Render Diagnostic Screen: Adds a new screen 'new_render_check' before home_intro that verifies desktop graphics overlay compatibility and display positioning. (why: 3 support tickets reported that pets fail to show up on the desktop screen or the app fails to open after waiting.)
5: [finish, hint] Desktop Controls & Tray Access Callout Hint: Adds explicit instructions on the home_intro screen on how to access pet controls via system tray or right-clicking the desktop mascot. (why: 3 support tickets detailed post-onboarding confusion regarding how to control, hide, or talk to the pet.)
6: [choose_path, copy] Clear Path Outcome Copy Optimization: Updates headlines and body copy on choose_path screen to explicitly detail the exact difference between choosing presets vs custom photo generation. (why: choose_path step conversion is 76.2% with a long mean duration of 514s, indicating uncertainty about what each path selection implies.)

scores.note: Addresses major funnel bottleneck (39.1% drop) and 3 support emails, but requires a new validation screen flow.
Targets low adoption conversion (60.9%), though evidence comes only from funnel metrics without support email validation.
Addresses extremely high wait duration on home screen; supported by duration data but lacks support mail signals.
Helps retention during 2336s mean render wait via system notifications; funnel duration evidence only.
Directly resolves 3 desktop render support tickets and long home wait times, but requires building a new diagnostic screen.
Backed by 3 support tickets and lower finish conversion (64.8%), though hint interventions historically show low lift.
